label: Call the person by the trigger word
instruction: If there is a person/character in the image you must refer to them as {name}.

label: Lighting
instruction: Include information about lighting.

label: Camera angle
instruction: Include information about camera angle.

label: Shot type (close-up to wide)
instruction: Mention whether the image depicts an extreme close-up, close-up, medium close-up, medium shot, cowboy shot, medium wide shot, wide shot, or extreme wide shot.

label: Not the resolution
instruction: Do NOT mention the image's resolution.

label: No “This image shows…”
instruction: Your response will be used by a text-to-image model, so avoid useless meta phrases like “This image shows…”, "You are looking at...", etc.

label: Vantage height
instruction: Explicitly specify the vantage height (eye-level, low-angle worm’s-eye, bird’s-eye, drone, rooftop, etc.).

label: Depth of field
instruction: Specify the depth of field and whether the background is in focus or blurred.

label: Light sources
instruction: If applicable, mention the likely use of artificial or natural lighting sources.

label: Composition
instruction: Include information on the image's composition style, such as leading lines, rule of thirds, or symmetry.

label: Orientation
instruction: Identify the image orientation (portrait, landscape, or square) and aspect ratio if obvious.

label: Camera settings (photos)
instruction: If it is a photo you MUST include information about what camera was likely used and details such as aperture, shutter speed, ISO, etc.

label: Ages
instruction: Include information about the ages of any people/characters when applicable.

label: Not fixed traits
instruction: Do NOT include information about people/characters that cannot be changed (like ethnicity, gender, etc), but do still include changeable attributes (like hair style).

label: Watermark: say if there is one
instruction: Include information about whether there is a watermark or not.

label: Watermark: mention it
instruction: If there is a watermark, you must mention it.

label: JPEG artifacts
instruction: Include information about whether there are JPEG artifacts or not.

label: Aesthetic quality
instruction: You MUST include information about the subjective aesthetic quality of the image from low to very high.

label: Not the text in it
instruction: Do NOT mention any text that is in the image.

label: Not the mood
instruction: Do not mention the mood/feeling/etc of the image.

label: No ambiguous language
instruction: Do NOT use any ambiguous language.

label: Only the main elements
instruction: ONLY describe the most important elements of the image.

label: No artist or title
instruction: If it is a work of art, do not include the artist's name or the title of the work.

label: SFW / suggestive / NSFW
instruction: Include whether the image is sfw, suggestive, or nsfw.

label: Keep it PG
instruction: Do NOT include anything sexual; keep it PG.
